title: One-Sided Leg Swelling and Pain
summary: One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, and calf pain are reasons not to massage the leg until medically assessed.
goal: Help recognize an important stop sign before leg massage.
startingPosition: Compare both legs and notice new asymmetry.
instructions: Do not massage a painful or noticeably swollen leg.
Do not deeply knead a painful calf.
Seek medical care if symptoms are sudden or pronounced.
tips: Uncertainty is enough reason to reduce intensity or postpone massage.
Safety takes priority over completing a plan.
mistakes: Trying to continue at any cost.
Making overly confident conclusions without professional assessment.
warning: This guide is educational and does not replace medical diagnosis or individualized professional advice.
